name: Minimap
intent: A compact, north-rotating satellite minimap with a centre pin and heading view-cone.

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @corensystem/coren-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.

props.name: lon
props.description: Longitude of the site the minimap is centred on.

props.name: lat
props.description: Latitude of the site the minimap is centred on.

props.name: heading
props.description: Compass heading, in degrees, the viewer is currently facing. The map rotates opposite to it.

props.name: label
props.description: Label rendered in the top-left corner chip.

props.name: src
props.description: Override the map tile image source. Defaults to an ArcGIS World Imagery export for `lon`/`lat`.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

usage: Use Minimap to enhance your user interface. This component provides a consistent, accessible, and well-designed solution for this use case.
Minimap integrates seamlessly with other components in the design system. Follow the established patterns and guidelines to ensure consistency across your application.
